description: One variant by dbSNP rsID: gene, star-allele or common name, alleles, functional effect, population frequency and sources. Send the rsID only, never the user's genotype. To compare a raw DNA file, do it in the agent with the record's reading block (GRCh37 plus-strand reference and variant allele): skip it when countable is false, don't trust A/T or C/G positions (strand_ambiguous) unless the file's strand is known, and treat a chip call of a rare pathogenic variant as unconfirmed. A count at one position is not a phenotype or metabolizer status.
name: lookup_variant
title: Look up a variant
